claim_rule: No release may claim protocol compliance until every release gate passes, the Compliance Document is approved, independent appraisal is current, and trained-user controls are enabled.

cases.title: Permitted structural-system and DtS scope
cases.acceptance: Protocol mode accepts only appraised steel or timber trussed roof/floor or framed-building systems using declared NCC DtS criteria; all other systems use the engineer-review workflow.

cases.title: NCC geometric limits
cases.acceptance: Protocol mode records and enforces eaves height <= 6 m, roof height <= 8.5 m, width <= 16 m, length <= 5 x width and roof pitch <= 35 degrees before producing design outputs.

cases.title: Approval inputs are identifiable
cases.acceptance: Every job input used by analysis is identified in the evidence pack with value, unit, source, locked/discretionary classification and analysis digest.

cases.title: Engineering criteria cannot be silently overridden
cases.acceptance: Locked engineering criteria cannot be edited by a trained user; every permitted non-engineering override is identified in outputs and changes the analysis identity.

cases.title: Input self-checks fail closed
cases.acceptance: Missing, contradictory, invalid and out-of-range inputs produce a specific blocking diagnostic and no protocol design output.

cases.title: Engineer-supplied inputs are explicit
cases.acceptance: Any input requiring an engineer is labelled at entry and in output, with engineer identity, reference and controlled revision; its presence prevents trained-user-only sign-off unless the Compliance Document permits it.

cases.title: Software, release and approval identity
cases.acceptance: Every output identifies Tertius, the unique software/engine version, analysis identity, protocol edition, appraisal status and Compliance Document location/version.

cases.title: NCC and referenced-document register
cases.acceptance: Outputs identify the applicable NCC edition/amendment and every structural standard or referenced document used by the selected calculation packs.

cases.title: Installation, transport and use constraints
cases.acceptance: Output contains the appraised fabrication, transport, erection, bracing, connection, support and installation constraints needed for the result to remain valid.

cases.title: No protocol output outside approved limits
cases.acceptance: Changing any scope boundary beyond its approved value blocks protocol output and explains the violated limit; the engineer-review pathway remains available without a protocol claim.

cases.title: Trained-user identity and currency
cases.acceptance: Protocol output contains the user's name, training certificate number, trained software version and current validity; expired or wrong-version training blocks trained-user sign-off.

cases.title: Reference calculations and component selection
cases.acceptance: Independent hand calculations or trusted reference solutions agree within predeclared tolerances for actions, combinations, analysis effects, member capacities, stability, connections, serviceability and selected components.

cases.title: Representative and boundary job matrix
cases.acceptance: The appraised matrix covers supported frame types, materials, wind regions, terrain/shielding/topography cases, openings, roof pitches, dimensions, member families, connections and governing load combinations, including each boundary and one increment beyond it.

cases.title: All required and selected sub-checks fail closed
cases.acceptance: A failed, unsupported, blocked, stale or genuinely unchecked required result, including a selected nested connection result, prevents output; an irrelevant partial calculator is not represented as selected evidence.

cases.title: Immutable, reproducible review pack
cases.acceptance: The same saved analysis produces byte-identical evidence/report content and the independent verifier confirms file sizes, SHA-256 hashes, report identity, analysis identity and controlled-draft status.

cases.title: Formal QA system and independent verification
cases.acceptance: Controlled QA procedures identify requirements, design reviews, tests, defects, releases, records, independence and approval responsibilities; the appraiser samples traceability from requirement to evidence to release.

cases.title: Competent structural software author
cases.acceptance: The Compliance Document identifies the responsible software author and evidence of structural engineering competence appropriate to the appraised scope.

cases.title: Current-version training and certificate controls
cases.acceptance: Training covers the approved version, scope, inputs, outputs, limitations and escalation rules; completion issues a unique certificate and version updates trigger review or retraining.

cases.title: Compliance Document completeness
cases.acceptance: The controlled Compliance Document covers scope/exclusions, ownership and qualifications, NCC/standards, installation, validation, QA, training, revision history, input/analysis/output features, screens and worked examples.

cases.title: Written independent appraisal
cases.acceptance: An independent structural assessor reviews the complete FAT evidence and Compliance Document, records qualifications/method/results, certifies the approved scope in writing and states validity and conditions.

cases.title: NCC currency, unique versions and approval status
cases.acceptance: Each release has a unique version and unambiguous appraisal status; NCC/standard changes and software changes trigger impact assessment, regression, Compliance Document revision and reappraisal/retraining as required.
